title: 第10章 灭门前夕
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林家，前山议事大厅内，气氛压抑。

大长老林崇山坐在家主之位上，脸色阴沉。

他死死盯着身前几名跪地颤抖的执事。

“还是没有找到？”

林崇山的声音沙哑，带着压抑不住的暴戾。

“回……回大长老，老祖的闭关密室、祖祠偏殿，乃至后山禁地，我等都带人搜了三遍。”

那名带头的炼气八层执事浑身冷汗直冒，颤声道，“根本没有……没有筑基丹的影子。而且，藏功阁和内务堂的账目……”

“账目怎么了？说！”

“内务堂的下品灵石，连带那五株准备上贡的百年份紫精草，早在一个月前就被老祖暗中提空了。如今的家族宝库，实际上……只剩下一个空壳子了。”

“噗通！”

那执事再也承受不住威压，直接瘫软在地。

林崇山长长地吐出一口气，整个人像是瞬间苍老了十岁。

他瘫坐在椅子上，眼中满是愤怒与一丝隐藏极深的恐惧。

筑基丹没了，家族数百年的积攒也没了。

那该死的老鬼，在尝试突破金丹之前，竟然把林家的家底掏得一干二净！

他林崇山机关算尽，到头来，得到的竟然只是一个摇摇欲坠的空壳家族。

“废物！给我把近一个月进过老祖密室的人都叫过来！老夫要搜魂！”

林崇山猛地一拍石案，筑基初期的威压轰然散开，将身前的石案震出一道道蛛网般的裂纹。

“大长老！不好了！”

就在此时，一名满身是血的嫡系弟子连滚带爬地冲进大厅，惨叫道：“陈家！刘家！他们打过来了！”

林崇山霍然起身，脸色惨白：“什么？怎么会？！”

“陈家老祖和刘家老祖亲自带队，已经到了山门外！”

林家山门外，百丈高空。

一艘通体漆黑、散发着淡淡灵光的法舟悬停在半空。

法舟之上，两道散发着强大灵力波动的身影并肩而立，俯瞰着林家那层摇摇欲坠的淡蓝色护族大阵。

左侧一人，身着一袭青纹长袍，面容枯槁，双眼阴鸷，周身散发着筑基中期的磅礴威压，正是陈家老祖陈万河。

身材魁梧的中年壮汉立于右侧，赤裸着上身，皮肤呈现出古铜色的金属光泽，手持一柄门板大小的巨斧，其筑基初期的气血之力显然高于寻常初期修士，此人便是刘家老祖刘莽。

“陈兄，你那内应的情报当真稳妥？林玄鹤那老王八蛋，真的坐化了？”

刘莽吐了一口唾沫，声如洪钟，眼中闪烁着残忍而贪婪的光芒。

陈万河冷笑一声，枯瘦的手指轻轻捻着胡须：“我那外务管事陈平亲眼见过林崇山，我派出去的内应也暗中观察了七日，林崇山那老小子的反应骗不了人。林玄鹤若还活着，借林崇山十个胆子，他也不敢封锁祖祠、自立为王。如今林家内部空虚，正是将其连根拔起的绝佳时机。”

“哈哈，好！林家占据这青阳郡南部的玄铁矿脉和两条一阶灵脉多年，合该换换主人了！”

刘莽哈哈大笑，声音震荡得护山大阵泛起一圈涟漪。

The atmosphere in the Lin family's Qianshan meeting hall was depressing.

The Great Elder Lin Chongshan was sitting on the throne of the family head with a gloomy expression.

He stared intently at the several deacons kneeling and trembling in front of him.

"Still not found?"

Lin Chongshan's voice was hoarse and filled with irrepressible violence.

"Back to... Back to the great elder, we have led people to search the ancestor's secret retreat room, the side hall of the ancestral temple, and even the forbidden area in the back mountain three times."

The leading eighth-level Qi Refining deacon broke out in cold sweat and said in a trembling voice, "There is no... no sign of the Foundation Establishment Pill. Moreover, the accounts of the Hidden Gong Pavilion and the Internal Affairs Hall..."

"What happened to the accounts? Tell me!"

"The low-grade spiritual stones in the Internal Affairs Hall, together with the five hundred-year-old purple essence grass that was prepared for tribute, were secretly emptied by the ancestors a month ago. Today, the family treasure house is actually...only an empty shell."

"Plop!"

The deacon could no longer bear the pressure and collapsed to the ground.

Lin Chongshan let out a long breath, and his whole figure seemed to have aged ten years in an instant.

He slumped in his chair, his eyes full of anger and a trace of deeply hidden fear.

The Foundation Establishment Pill is gone, and the family's hundreds of years of accumulation are gone.

That damn old ghost, before trying to break through the golden elixir, actually wiped out all the Lin family's wealth!

Lin Chongshan had tried all his tricks, but in the end, all he got was a crumbling empty shell of the family.

"Trash! Call me all the people who have entered the ancestor's secret room in the past month! I want to search for souls!"

Lin Chongshan slapped the stone case suddenly, and the pressure from the initial stage of foundation building suddenly dissipated, causing spiderweb-like cracks to appear on the stone case in front of him.

"Great Elder! It's not good!"

At this moment, a direct disciple covered in blood rushed into the hall and screamed: "Chen family! Liu family! They are coming!"

Lin Chongshan stood up suddenly, his face pale: "What? How could it be?!"

"The ancestors of the Chen family and the Liu family personally led the team and have arrived outside the mountain gate!"

Outside the gate of Linjiashan, it's a hundred feet high in the sky.

A dark vessel with a faint spiritual light hovered in the air.

On top of the dharma boat, two figures emitting powerful spiritual energy fluctuations stood side by side, overlooking the crumbling light blue clan-protecting formation of the Lin family.

The person on the left is wearing a blue-patterned robe, with a haggard face and sinister eyes. He exudes the majestic pressure of the middle stage of foundation construction. He is Chen Wanhe, the ancestor of the Chen family.

A burly middle-aged man stands on the right side, with his upper body bare and his skin showing a bronze metallic luster. He holds a giant ax the size of a door panel. His energy and blood strength in the early stages of foundation building is obviously higher than that of ordinary early stage monks. This man is Liu Mang, the ancestor of the Liu family.

"Brother Chen, is your internal intelligence information really reliable? Is that old bastard Lin Xuanhe really dead?"

Liu Mang spat, the sound was like a bell, his eyes flashed with cruelty and greed.

Chen Wanhe sneered and gently twirled his beard with his thin fingers: "My foreign affairs officer Chen Ping saw Lin Chongshan with his own eyes, and the internal officers I sent out also secretly observed it for seven days. The reaction of that old boy Lin Chongshan cannot be deceived. If Lin Xuanhe was still alive, with Lin Chongshan's ten courages, he would not dare to block the ancestral temple and establish himself as king. Now that the Lin family is empty, it is the perfect time to uproot it."

"Haha, okay! The Lin family has occupied the black iron veins and two first-order spiritual veins in the southern part of Qingyang County for many years. It's time to change owners!"

Liu Mang laughed loudly, and his voice shook the mountain-protecting formation with ripples.
